title: Robustness of Climate Models at Unresolved Scales
exact_target: Determine suitable rough solution spaces and robust approximations for reduced climate models, and identify the stochastic structures needed at unresolved scales.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005985 (OWR-14298586-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Model Hierarchies in Atmosphere, Ocean, and Climate Sciences (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/31, pp. 1731--1786. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Selecting a stochastic framework depends on the particular equation and covariance; the source asks whether simpler noise models suffice, not whether every model needs all three advanced theories.
